WITH ping AS (
                UPDATE v2_job_runtime SET ping = null WHERE id = $2
            ), place AS (
                UPDATE concurrency_key
                SET original_scheduled_for = (SELECT scheduled_for FROM v2_job_queue WHERE id = $2),
                    place = (SELECT scheduled_for FROM v2_job_queue WHERE id = $2)
                WHERE job_id = $2 AND original_scheduled_for IS NULL
            )
            UPDATE v2_job_queue SET
                running = false,
                started_at = null,
                scheduled_for = $1
            WHERE id = $2
